title: Manasse: The King's Apostasy and Repentance
description: King Manasseh leads Judah into deep idolatry and is taken captive to Babylon by the commanders of the Assyrian army. In his distress, he humbles himself before God, is brought back to Jerusalem, removes the idols, and restores the Lord's altar. [ref:2 Chr 33:1-20|2 Chronicles 33:1-20]
